title: Additivity and base scalar compatibility of affine tensor cohomology
statement: Let R,A,B be commutative rings with R-algebra structures on A and B, and i an integer. The source and target cohomology functors [def-pc-ring-tensor-cohomology] on unbounded A-complexes are additive. For both functors K, every A-complex M and r in R, K maps multiplication by algebraMap R A r on M to multiplication by algebraMap R B r on K(M). There is no flatness or boundedness hypothesis.
